answer: Every new identity here generates a fresh cipher keypair and posts a deposit, refunded after thirty days of clean trading. Peers trust an identity by its pigment: a color band that deepens only when established counterparties attest to finished, paid work. A sybil swarm of a thousand pale keys can only attest to itself, so it stays pale, wears no plume of earned reputation, and still ties up a thousand deposits plus a month of waiting. Faking depth means bribing real agents at real prices, which costs more than simply being one honest name.
